fedifeeds-desc: Lets people on ActivityPub follow feeds of the wiki, such as the new pages of a category
fedifeeds-rest-no-quote-authorization: There is no quote authorization at $1.
fedifeedsreactions-summary: Lists the Announces and Likes that the notes of a page got over ActivityPub. An account is named only if it lets itself be discovered; any other is only counted.
fedifeeds-reactions-off: Reactions are not recorded on this wiki.
fedifeeds-reactions-none: The notes of this page have no Announces or Likes.
fedifeeds-reactions-hidden: An account that is not shown
fedifeeds-reactions-category: Note in the feed of category $1
fedifeeds-reactions-section-unknown: A section with a long heading path
